restInst.description: An instance of the REST type.

sourceControlRepoName.description: The name of the repository set up in the respective source control host (e.g. `c3server`).

token.description: The personal access token used to access repo and construct the {@link SourceControlRestApi} instance

zeroSha.description:
This sha is used for updateRefs() calls to represent a nonexistent branch.
It has 40 '0's.

When creating a new branch, it should be used as the oldObjectId.  When deleting
a branch, it should be used as the newObjectId.

numMergeTries.description:
The number of times to check if a merge is successful.  Merging involves waiting for a
pull request to be completed, which happens asynchronously.

secondsBetweenMergeRetries.description: The number of seconds to wait between checking if a merge is successful.

title: Type to access AzureDevOps through REST.
